item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Mona has monthly scores $4,7,4,9,7$ for months $1$ through $5$ in that order. She builds a dot plot of those scores on a number line.

Which claim about the dot plot is correct?

options.A: Call the display a number line only, without reading frequencies, min, max, range, or clusters from the dots.
options.B: Read min $4$, max $9$, and frequencies from the dots, and also claim the dot plot still shows which month had which score, skipping that month order can be lost.
options.C: From the dots she can read values, frequencies (two $4$s, two $7$s, one $9$), min $4$, max $9$, and range $5$, but she cannot recover which month held which score from the dots alone.
options.D: Say that writing the frequencies is what creates the dots on the number line, instead of reading frequency from the dots already placed.
